title: Knowledge fragment
description: An atomic, typed, provenance-carrying claim mined from one source. Fragments are the substrate the forge skill bridges over. Every claim a surviving hypothesis makes must bind to a fragment (the 'no fragment -> no claim' rule); a fragment with no live source_id is invalid.

ontology_id.description: Normalized id: gene Ensembl/HGNC, disease EFO/MONDO, drug ChEMBL/ChEBI. What makes cross-corpus fragments comparable.

predicate.description: Normalized relation, e.g. inhibits, upregulated_in, associated_with, antagonizes, indicated_for, failed_in, does_not_cross.

evidence_span.description: The exact quoted text / data value the claim is read from — never paraphrased into existence.

source_id.description: Resolvable pointer: PMID, DOI, bioRxiv id, GEO GSE, ChEMBL id, Open Targets association, NCT number.

confidence.description: Source-derived confidence (curation level, effect size, statistical support).

snapshot_date.description: When the source was read. Also the time-slice key for retrospective evaluation.
